content: The integration of advanced energy storage systems, smart grid technologies, and highly efficient installation practices will be critical for industry stakeholders aiming to secure a competitive advantage. While the enduring dominance of coal suggests that the complete macroeconomic transition to renewables as the primary energy source will likely remain gradual, the structural pivot is undeniable [54] .
